newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Miners' confederation CNCSMR based in the coal town of Tirgu Jiu ended a labour conflict after talks with government representatives over their claims on pay rises, improved working conditions and better social protection.
* Parliament's lower Chamber of Deputies debated amendments to a land restitution law aimed at speeding up land restitution and creating larger land properties to improve farm output.
* The upper Senate started debates on the draft law on organisation of the justice system, in a bid to reform the sector and ensure its independence from the government influence.

* Employees of the Azochim Piatra Neamt chemical plant blocked roads on Tuesday in a protest against the government's failure to support the company's development and give it soft loans for its investments.
* Foreign Minister Adrian Severin starts Western European tour to lobby for his country's admission into NATO and the European Union.

Severin is expected to meet his Belgian counterpart Erik Derycke in Brussels and then his British opposite number Robin Cook in London. He will also visit Amsterdam to discuss Romania's EU membership.

* A hailstorm hit again the southern county of Olt and damaged the telephone and electricity network in five villages. Two people were taken to hospital in a serious condition due to injuries caused by hailstones.
